# Test fixtures

Inputs for the round-trip parsers under `niflow.formats`.

## `nested_groups.flow.json`
Generated by deploying `examples/nested_groups.py` to local NiFi 2.7.2 and hitting
`GET /process-groups/{id}/download` (a.k.a. `ProcessGroupsApi.export_process_group`).
Format: NiFi 2.x `VersionedFlowSnapshot` JSON. Covers nested groups + ports +
processors + cross-group connections; **no controller services** (the example
doesn't use any).

## `simple_httpget_route.template.xml`
Pulled from the NiFi wiki's example dataflow templates page:
https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/download/attachments/57904847/simple-httpget-route.template.xml
Format: NiFi 1.x `<template><snippet>...</snippet></template>` XML. Covers
processors + connections only (4 procs, 3 conns, no services/ports/groups).
